Include one substantial horizontal industrial beam across the upper quarter of the frame with a clearly visible flat underside, leaving clear space beneath it for a separate creature sprite that the game will add later. No creature is painted in the beam, ceiling, shadows or walls. Resin curls and ribs follow and fuse with the steel; do not make red flesh, veins, bones, a mouth or a fantasy cave. Cold blue-green ambient illumination, one dim warm service light deep in the gallery, sparse wet reflections. Detailed grounded 1980s industrial science-fiction game art, quiet threatening atmosphere, readable forms at 1280x536, texture compatible with the supplied game images. No people, no hands, no weapon, no victims, no eggs, no monsters, no blood, no gore. No text, lettering, numerals, REC indicator, crosshair, HUD, scanlines, noise or black letterbox bars; these are supplied by the game. generation.prompt: Use case: an isolated environmental game sprite that sits BEHIND a separate native human character. Create ONE EMPTY upright wall-grown resin support on a fully transparent background, frontal view, portrait composition about 2:3. The first reference is used ONLY for the ribbed dark amber-black resin attaching a human to a hive wall. Exclude its actor, face, body, clothing, wound, blood and chestburster. From the second reference use ONLY the three photographs on the RIGHT for Aliens (1986) hive resin topology and material; exclude the Queen. The third reference sets the project's rendering style. The resulting object is an original support sized for one standing adult: an irregular shallow concave nest of layered ribbed biomechanical resin, wider at shoulder height and tapering near the lower legs, with root-like resin filaments resting on a single horizontal ground contact line. Leave an OPEN CENTRAL CHANNEL large enough for the head, torso, arms and legs of the separate character: this channel must show true transparency, including the face clearance, rather than contain a painted humanoid shadow or body. Build an irregular dark resin frame around that empty channel, with a few small filaments behind its edges, but NO straps or ribs crossing the central opening. The nine breakable front bindings are animated by game code and must not be baked into this image. This is not an egg, a sealed alien chrysalis, a cocoon containing a monster, a sarcophagus, a throne or a chair. No identifiable human shape, no head, no hands, no skeleton, no alien parts, no chestburster, no gore or blood. Rich but restrained wet charcoal/umber resin with cool grey-blue specular edges and faint amber translucence at thin edges, matching physical 1980s creature-set materials, not bright slime or neon. Keep every resin tip and the entire low root base inside the canvas, with at least 7 percent transparent margin at top, bottom, left and right. No floor plane, wall rectangle, cast shadow patch, text, logo, badge, border or frame. One sprite only, no panels or variants.
